title: Cambridge IELTS 15 Test 2 Writing Task 2
directions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Write about the following topic:
prompt:
In the future, nobody will buy printed newspapers or books because they will be able to read everything they want online without paying.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
scenario: In the future, nobody will buy printed newspapers or books because they will be able to read everything they want online without paying.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
